title: Add heuristic retrieval instruction to CLAUDE.md
rationale: ERL shows that injecting relevant heuristics at task start gives +7.8% performance lift. Adding a CLAUDE.md instruction to consult heuristics.md when starting complex tasks ensures the lesson pool is actually used, not just maintained.
content:
## Heuristic Retrieval (ERL-Inspired)

Before starting any complex task, scan `/workspace/group/heuristics.md` for relevant lessons:
- Coding/environment tasks → check Tools & Environment section
- Trading research tasks → check Research & Backtesting section
- Podcast/content tasks → check Podcast & Content Pipeline section
- Memory operations → check Memory & Self-Improvement section

After completing a task that produced a new generalizable lesson, append it to the relevant section of `heuristics.md`. Use the format:
```
### [Short title]
- LESSON: [The generalizable principle]
- WHEN: [When to apply this lesson]
- SOURCE: [File or paper that produced this lesson]
```

Do NOT add task-specific debugging details — only lessons that will generalize to future tasks.
